prose: Pathos AI, which applies AI to oncology drug development, raised a $237 million Series E at a $3 billion post-money valuation - nearly doubling the $1.6 billion valuation of its $365 million Series D in May 2025, Axios reports.
highlights: Pathos AI raised a $237M Series E at a $3B post-money valuation (Axios)
Up from $1.6B after its $365M Series D in May 2025
Applies AI to precision-oncology drug development
